## Service Gateway — بوابة الخدمات (الحوكمة التنفيذية)
EVERY tool call the agent makes passes through here:
1) the skill's `allowed_services` allowlist is enforced from the signed registry — a call outside the list returns SERVICE_DENIED_BY_GOVERNANCE;
2) every call (including denials) writes an AuditLog row.
The agent cannot touch data any other way. (Criteria ①⑤⑥)
